capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Honda press kit: 20 kWh lithium-ion pack from Toshiba (SCiB).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Honda publishes only "20 kWh"; no usable figure on any page opened, so the nominal 20 kWh is recorded as usable with no further basis. OWNER QUESTION.

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: Toshiba SCiB cells with a lithium titanate oxide (LTO) anode; enum has no LTO, so other.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: No page gives the pack voltage (Honda's review only says many low-voltage SCiB cells are in series). 400 V class is elimination only (no 800 V production car existed in 2013), not a sourced or relative-based figure. OWNER QUESTION.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Absence of mention: the press kit describes an air-cooled battery (fans) and AC-only charging with no battery-warming feature; no page states the absence outright.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: The US press kit describes only 120/240 V AC charging on an SAE J1772 port; no DC inlet mentioned. (Japan model had a quick-charge inlet, per a Honda R&D paper seen in a search excerpt.)

ac_max_kw.notes: Honda press kit: 6.6 kW onboard 32-amp charger, 240 V in under three hours.
